QUOTE: "MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO=my_calloc and MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO=my_free. Both macros must be set together." and "Runtime: define only MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY, then call mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(calloc_fn, free_fn)" and "`mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` is compiled out."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair and says the runtime setter is compiled out when the macros are defined, which is the mutual exclusivity.
